en: James 5

p.src: 1  Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

p.src: 2  Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

en: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
u.src: 2  Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

p.src: 3  Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

のようにあなたがたの

p.src: 4  Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

en: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

p.src: 5  You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

ja: にふけってきました。屠りの
を肥やしてきたのです。
en: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

en: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
u.src: 6  You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

p.src: 7  Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

ja: りを待ち、大地が初めの
en: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

p.src: 8  You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

en: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
u.src: 8  You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

p.src: 9  Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

ja: たち、裁かれないために、
en: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
u.src: 9  Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

p.src: 10  Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

en: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
u.src: 10  Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

い慈しみとあわれみに

p.src: 12  But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

ja: にかけても、そのほかどのような
ってはなりません。ただ、「はい」は「はい」、「いいえ」は「いいえ」としなさい。偽善に
en: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
u.src: 12  But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

en: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

en: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

en: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

en: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

た人がいて、だれかがその
